description: Machine-readable catalog of reusable agent skills in this repository.

skills.name: brainstorming
skills.description: You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, or modifying behavior. Explores user intent, requirements and design before implementation.
skills.when: Before any creative, implementation, or behavior-changing task.

skills.name: writing-plans
skills.description: Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code.
skills.when: After a spec/design is approved and before implementation begins.

skills.name: executing-plans
skills.description: Use when you have a written implementation plan to execute in a separate session with review checkpoints.
skills.when: When a written implementation plan exists and the user wants it executed.

skills.name: wiki-ingest
skills.description: Ingest material into the LLM Wiki at ~/writing/llm-wiki, creating atomic concept pages and wikilinks.
skills.when: When the user wants to ingest material into the LLM Wiki.

skills.name: wiki-lint
skills.description: Lint the health of the LLM Wiki at ~/writing/llm-wiki and fix issues after confirmation.
skills.when: When the user wants to check or clean up the LLM Wiki.

skills.name: wiki-query
skills.description: Query the LLM Wiki at ~/writing/llm-wiki and synthesize answers, optionally backfilling knowledge.
skills.when: When the user wants to query the LLM Wiki for knowledge.

skills.name: wiki-html
skills.description: Build a self-contained interactive HTML page via the artifact-design workflow and archive it into the LLM Wiki's html/ directory with a companion page and log entry.
skills.when: When the user wants an interactive HTML page produced for and archived into the LLM Wiki.
